interpretation_rules: The existing primary H2 remains a confirmatory test of A1_plus_hold6 and E3_plus_hold6.
This diagnostic uses only the January-June development block and must not read July-December candidate results.
A candidate is not promoted because it has the highest result at one horizon.
Horizon results are interpreted as a response surface; isolated peaks are not evidence of a stable exit.
MFE and MAE are descriptive path diagnostics, not executable exit results.
No failed H1 candidate is rescued into the active H2 from this diagnostic.
Any new entry-plus-exit strategy generated from this diagnostic requires a separate pre-registration and a later untouched validation block.
Core and MT4 remain unchanged and are the final source of truth after research validation.
